### A Later Enrolment Is Recorded as an Admission From the Delivery Room or on the Day of Birth {#sec-problem-details-25}

Each hospital stay of a patient is recorded as an enrolment of its own, and the admission form of each enrolment records how the infant came to the department: from the delivery room after a birth in the hospital, transferred or readmitted to the hospital on the day of birth, or transferred or readmitted the day after birth or later.
An enrolment that follows an earlier enrolment of the same patient is a readmission by definition, and a readmission after the day of birth is recorded with the third of these admission types.
This message appears in the validation report when a later enrolment of a patient records one of the first two.

Either the admission type of the later enrolment is wrong, or the two enrolments describe the same hospital stay.

Please open the later enrolment's admission form (see @sec-solution-15), reopen it for editing if it is completed (see @sec-solution-9) and correct the admission type together with the day of life at admission.
If the two enrolments describe one stay, please delete the redundant one instead (see @sec-solution-13).
